newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon raises Bethlehem.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon raises Bethlehem.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers steel analyst Michelle Applebaum said she raised her 1997 full-year estimate on Bethlehem Steel Corp to $1.00 per share from $0.77 per share.
-- Applebaum said she raised the estimate due to the company's better-than-expected first quarter.
-- Bethlehem Steel on Tuesday reported first-quarter earnings of $0.25 per share. Applebaum said her estimate had been $0.14 per share.
-- "Bethlehem's restructuring plan is showing results faster than predicted...we expect earnings to continue to grow," Applebaum said.
